findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_revenue_check, get_money_system · Private data: run_revenue_check, get_latest_findings, list_checks · Public sink: get_money_system · Destructive: run_revenue_check, get_latest_findings, list_checks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_revenue_check, get_money_system · Private data: run_revenue_check, get_latest_findings, list_checks · Public sink: get_money_system · Destructive: run_revenue_check, get_latest_findings, list_checks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
